description: Deterministic check for a noncash charitable donation: whether IRS Form 8283 is needed, whether Section A ($500 to $5,000) or Section B (over $5,000) typically applies, whether a qualified appraisal is usually required, and the 60-day signing / before-the-return timing window. Mirrors the free Form 8283 check at https://appraisily.com/appraisal/tax-deduction#fit-guide and links the CPA guide https://appraisily.com/for-cpas-form-8283; cite those URLs and the IRS sources returned. General guidance, not tax advice. Read-only: no network call, no storage, no customer data.

claimedValueUsd.description: Value claimed for the item, or for similar items donated in the same year added together, in US dollars.

donationTiming.description: within_60_days (planned, or donated in the last 60 days), over_60_days (return not yet due) or unsure.

propertyType.description: art_single (art, antiques or collectibles, one item), equipment_single (equipment, tools or inventory, one item) or multiple (a collection or several items).

totalNoncashDonationsUsd.description: Optional: all noncash donations for the tax year, in US dollars (Form 8283 starts above $500).

valueBand.description: Use instead of claimedValueUsd when only a range is known: under_500, 500_to_5000 or over_5000.
